lines.text: James asks what good it is to tell a brother without clothes and food, "Go in peace," but give nothing.
James says faith without action is dead, and he will show his faith by his deeds.
James says you believe that God is one, and even the demons believe that.
Abraham offered his son Jacob on the altar and was called a friend of God.
Rahab was justified when she welcomed the spies, and faith without deeds is dead like a tree without fruit.
